name: Status Window Diagnostics

It is the window's title block and its Permissions section at 640x552, 1x; the build's capture is the whole window at 767x977 and carries the Tools section below the frame the reference stops at. name: ScreenCaptureKit Visual Engine
reason: no design of record — this surface is a capture engine, and its evidence is a photograph the engine took of another application's window. There is nothing drawn to compare it against, so the pair is structurally unjudgeable rather than unjudged. What settles it is the frame's own status and trustworthiness, which the manifest carries.
